item.text: {"hypothesis":"For repository-wide test commands, predict an early dependency-gated failure mode versus a genuine full-suite execution mode from causally earlier exit status/result excerpts and successful dependency-install commands. The early-failure mode has low latency/resources, while the same command after missing dependencies are installed reaches high latency, CPU, and RSS; Current repeatedly conflates these modes.","selected_sample_ids":["S00067","S00071","S00129","S00134","S00195","S00200","S00300","S00304","S00359","S00364","S00628","S00635"],"why_agent_needed":"An agent must interpret bounded earlier results to determine whether prior full-suite attempts stopped on missing imports and whether subsequent installs succeeded; command structure alone cannot distinguish the two execution modes."}
